spec: docs/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md s.4 items #1-13; geometry tests on the front-orthographic SDF silhouette (3 mm grid), value tests on the 1200x900 front render + mask png. #1 is JUDGMENT (with proxies). See README for known tension items.

G1a.name: G1a Descending Figure (c01-faithful): tall trunk + root column, head set into trunk top, 6 limbs staggered
G1a.gesture: G1 vertical trunk, slight S (head +8 mm)

1.note: head disc + shouldered torso + >=6 separable tapered tips; reads tentacled figure (octopus-person) in silhouette; shelves not needed to name it

4.note: top level = lum >= 0.85 x mask median (image is mostly wall, so percentile V4 would not isolate the mask)

6.note: tips distinct at 64 px (14.3 mm/px) if gap >= 2 px = 28.6 mm

7.note: widths = designed section widths of the limb sweep alone (plate excluded); root = first sample outside the body silhouette; tip = t 0.97 (width must land in the 12-25 mm band); length range 0.40-0.65 W per checklist (feature-ref 6-10x root width is longer than the envelope allows)

9.named: G1 vertical trunk, slight S (head +8 mm)

11.note: shelf-top runs are the spec flat top (>=150 mm): inherent conflict with the 120 mm rule, listed apart; JUDGMENT: plate corners R26, plan outline wobbled superellipse, no posts, shelf is the tangent flare of the limb tail
